name: patient_age_value_recorded_now_in_years
meaning: Numeric value indicating the patient's current age in years.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current age in years is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the patient's current age in years if it is known and documented.

name: patient_has_adequate_command_of_english_language_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has adequate command of the English language.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has adequate command of the English language.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have adequate command of the English language.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has adequate command of the English language.

name: patient_possesses_mobile_phone_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently possesses a mobile phone.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently possesses a mobile phone.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not possess a mobile phone.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently possesses a mobile phone.
